params.difference_convention: T(r,d) = T(r,d-1) - T(r-1,d-1) (backward); T(r,0) = pi(b^r) - pi(b^(r-1))
params.support: r = d+1 .. R; cells with r < d+1 do not exist
params.first_block_convention: pi(1) = 0 (1 is neither prime nor composite). Block r covers the half-open interval (b^(r-1), b^r], so block 1 is (1, b] and excludes 1. Hence N_2(1) = pi(2) = 1 and N_3(1) = pi(3) = 2.
params.smooth_anchor: M(b^0) = M(1) := 0 for BOTH smooth models, mirroring pi(1) = 0. This is a CHOICE: li(1) = -infinity and R(1) = 1, so neither model extends to x = 1 naturally. Only the leading diagonal r = d+1 depends on it; those cells are flagged anchor_dependent.
params.precision: exact Python int for the prime table; mpf at dps_main for the smooth table and the residual; float only at report time

summary.r_max_note: each base runs its OWN full ladder; the dyadic side is not truncated to the triadic one
